limitations: Adjacent PSS block medians share 125 ms of IQ; even/odd fits measure this sensitivity.
Native-25 source gaps are excluded from search and shown as shaded intervals.
PSS and GLRT use different radio/LNB chains; absolute CFO and phase offsets are not shared.
First-sample UTC uncertainty can exceed one 1.333 ms frame period.
GLRT complex-baseband CFO physical sign is not independently calibrated.
PSS is template-relative; no SSS/payload decode establishes a complete OFDM frame boundary.

method.dense_frame_fit: strong local windows only; overlapping detections deduplicated by global 750 Hz frame epoch before cubic fit
method.glrt_global_alias_stitching: anchor largest Hough episode, align other episodes by integer 2.5 MHz/11 classes against an iterated robust quintic, and reject incompatible episodes; uses GLRT only
method.glrt_independent_track_selection: maximum published Hough observation count, then span
method.integrated_cross_observable_alignment: integrate each GLRT-only CFO/RF family and compare it with unwrapped PSS phase after fitting only constant phase and linear clock drift; physical and same-sign control use bidirectional 60/40 holdout
method.joint_pairing: compare the independently selected PSS track with each independently alias-stitched GLRT family over common temporal support
method.pss_fit: Huber-IRLS polynomial on unwrapped block-median phase; circular residuals
method.pss_search_rate: native 25 MS/s; decimation factor 1; no edge trim
method.pss_track_selection: independent: maximum published span, then mode count, then lower RMS
method.pss_window_geometry: complete 250 ms windows with 125 ms stride
